title: 'Choujun! Choujou-senpai' Unveils Main Cast, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shun Numa 's Choujun Choujou-senpai ( Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ) manga revealed the main cast, main visual (pictured right), and first promotional video on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Tuesdays at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mebius Dust Anime Announces 6 More Cast Members
content: The official website for Mebius Dust , Dōga Kōbō 's original television anime based on Hajime Shinagawa 's story of the same title, announced more cast members for the anime on Thursday: Hiroshi Tsuchida as Shippo Marimo, a flower shop's mascot and de facto head Ryōhei Shioguchi as Tenrō, the flower shop's heir Ryō…

title: New Live-Action GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka Series Streams Trailer
content: The staff for the new live-action series based on Tohru Fujisawa 's GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka manga unveiled a 90-second trailer for the series on Thursday. The series' official website also unveiled a new visual for the series.
author: ANN

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Casts Rina Honnizumi
content: The official website for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga announced on Thursday that Rina Honnizumi is joining the cast as Imoko, Yani Neko's little sister who is a model high school student.
author: ANN

title: Babies of Bread Stop-Motion TV Anime's New Video Announces Cast
content: The official website for the stop-motion television anime based on Japanese company CHOCOLATE Inc. 's CG anime film short " Babies of Bread " (" Pan no Aka-chan ") debuted the second promotional video for the anime on Thursday. The video announces the cast for the anime..
author: ANN

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Reveals July 19 Net Debut
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, revealed on Thursday the anime's key visual and July 19 debut. The anime will debut its three episodes on July 19 at 12:00 a.m.
author: ANN

title: 22 Years Later, One of The Greatest Psychological Anime Returns With an Official New Release
content: Naoki Urasawa is one of the most legendary manga creators of all time. Almost all of his works are always praised among readers for their exceptional art style and storytelling. While the creator is best known for Monster, a 1994 manga, he has also worked on more than a dozen titles.
author: ComicBook

title: 28 Years Later, The Greatest Psychological Thriller Anime of All Time Returns With an Official New Release
content: There are only a few anime films that can be considered outright classics among both critics and fans, and soon one of these classics is coming back to theaters with a brand new remaster to boot.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Already Found Its Next Big Hit After Kagurabachi
content: The Weekly Shonen Jump magazine by Shueisha is known for several acclaimed classics such as One Piece and Dragon Ball. The magazine has been serializing new series for decades, and each year, it introduces new series for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Streams Yasmine Gameplay Trailer
content: The official Street Fighter YouTube channel streamed a new video to preview the DLC character Yasmine's gameplay in the Street Fighter 6 game on Wednesday: English Trailer Japanese Trailer The game added Sagat on August 5, the first character in the Year 3 Character Pass. C.
